card.name: Place words ending a region phrase
card.fires_on: Words naming a broad area or region, such as galaxy, parts, elsewhere, interior, part and beyond, usually after 'these', 'this', 'the' or 'and'. Found in general web prose about geography or history.

modes.label: Vague regional nouns
modes.description: Parts or part after a demonstrative, meaning 'this area' or 'those regions'.
modes.example: and to the other bishops of those<< parts>>, that they may confirm this canon,

modes.label: Wider-area words
modes.description: Beyond, elsewhere, interior or galaxy closing a phrase about how far something extends.
modes.example: thoughts on our natural world in Oakland County and<< beyond>>.

card.plain: It fires on words that point to a wider area, like 'these parts', 'and beyond' or 'in our galaxy'.
